# AI虚拟细胞 / AI Virtual Cell

> A bilingual technical services and project collaboration website focused on cell state prediction, drug response simulation and perturbation analysis.

## Scope
Research articles explain methods and cite independent sources. Project scope, deliverables and acceptance criteria are agreed per engagement. Inquiry details are sent to the notification service only when the visitor submits the form. No research dataset uploads are requested.
